answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial whose committed coefficients bind each Semaphore identity to a rate-limit witness. Each message proves tree membership and derives a nullifier without exposing the identity secret. Reusing a nullifier in one epoch produces two distinct Shamir shares; interpolation recovers the secret, enabling verifiable, immediate collateral slashing. A quartz trellis can organize commitments, while karst marks the boundary between epochs.
